summary: No findings. The only new input is the players <select>. A tampered DOM value (an injected option, '', 'abc', '1e1', '6.5', '11') goes through Number(event.target.value), and the onChange handler only accepts values found in the frozen TABLE_SIZES list (2..10) via includes(). NaN and non-integers can never match, so state never leaves 2..10. configForPlayers checks the same list again and throws RangeError on anything else, so it fails closed. BOT_NAMES has 9 entries, which covers the 9 bots needed at 10 seats; the 'as string' cast is safe within that range. The labels and note text come from constants and are rendered as React text children. There is no dangerouslySetInnerHTML, so nothing can be injected. The change adds no network calls, storage, dependencies or randomness. The heads-up positionName branch is pure display logic.
